title: Osteoclastogenesis markers in craniofacial bone defects after demineralized dentin material membrane implantation as guided bone regeneration
authors: Mahendra, D. A., Yuliati, A., Razali, M., Kasim, N. H. A., Firdauzy, M. A. B., Roestamadji, R. I., & Soesilawati, P. (2025). Journal of applied oral science : revista FOB, 33, e20240254.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “DDMM has the potential to be a superior membrane substitute compared to PPCM as GBR in alternative treatment for craniofacial bone defects reconstruction” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
